mapper.select: select config_id, org_id, config_key, config_value, status from hm_mini_home_config where status = '0' order by config_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into hm_mini_home_config(org_id, config_key, config_value, status) values(#{orgId}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{status}) on duplicate key update config_value = values(config_value), status = values(status)
mapper.select: select nav_id, org_id, nav_name, nav_icon, nav_path, sort_no, status from hm_mini_nav_config where status = '0' order by sort_no asc, nav_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into hm_mini_nav_config(org_id, nav_name, nav_icon, nav_path, sort_no, status) values(#{orgId}, #{navName}, #{navIcon}, #{navPath}, #{sortNo}, #{status})
mapper.select:
select content_id, content_type, title, sub_title, cover_image, cover_image_storage, cover_image_object_key, summary, content_html, sort_no, publish_status, publish_time, update_time from hm_portal_content
and content_type like concat('%', #{contentType}, '%')
and title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and publish_status = #{publishStatus}
order by sort_no asc, update_time desc, content_id desc

select content_id, content_type, title, sub_title, cover_image, cover_image_storage, cover_image_object_key, summary, content_html, sort_no, publish_status, publish_time, update_time from hm_portal_content where publish_status = '1' and content_type = #{contentType} order by sort_no asc, publish_time desc, content_id desc limit 1
